chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Bunān ibn Muḥammad, from al-ʿAbbās, a غلام of Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, known as the غلام of Ibn Shurāʿah, from al-Ḥasan ibn al-Rabīʿ, from Sayf al-Tammār, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام was brought a man with a boy with whom he had intercourse, and the evidence was established against them for that. He said, “O Qanbar, the leather mat and the sword.” Then he ordered that the man be placed on his face and the boy be placed on his face, then he ordered regarding them, and they were struck with the sword until he split them both with the sword together.

He said: And Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام was brought two women who were found under one covering, and the evidence was established against them that they had been engaging in musāḥaqah. So he called for the leather mat, then ordered regarding them, and they were burned with fire.

key_terms.أُحْرِقَتَا بِالنَّارِ: they were burned with fire as the carried-out punishment
key_terms.السَّيْفَ: the sword used in the execution of the legal punishment
key_terms.النَّطْعَ: a leather mat or execution mat laid out for carrying out punishment
key_terms.الْبَيِّنَةُ: legal evidence or proof established before judgment
key_terms.تَتَسَاحَقَانِ: engaging in musāḥaqah, sexual acts between two women

ai.seo_question: What punishment is reported from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام for liwat and musāḥaqah when the evidence is established?
ai.summary: This hadith reports cases brought before Amīr al-Muʾminīn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام in which legal punishments were carried out after evidence had been established. It is cited in the context of hudud rulings related to liwat and musāḥaqah, reflecting the gravity of these offenses in the legal tradition.
